map.把文本转为难以阅读的形式：Unicode 全角、倒序、ROT13、Base64、: Convert text into hard-to-read forms: Unicode fullwidth, reverse, ROT13, Base64, hex escape, HTML entities — one-click copy, often used for code/script obfuscation.
map.对字符串做可逆或半可逆的混淆。: Apply reversible or semi-reversible obfuscation to strings.
map.：Unicode 转义、Base64、十六进制编码、字符拆分拼接、插入无意义字符: : Unicode escape, Base64, hex encoding, character splitting and concatenation, inserting meaningless characters.
map.：让字符串在源码中不易被直接检索或阅读。: : make strings harder to directly search for or read in source code.
map.：混淆不是加密，任何混淆都可被还原，无法保护真正的敏感信息。: : obfuscation is not encryption; any obfuscation can be reversed and cannot protect truly sensitive information.
map.：密钥与敏感配置不应放在前端，服务端保护才是根本手段。: : keys and sensitive configuration should not live in the front end; server-side protection is the fundamental measure.
map.把字符串转编码/数组形式隐藏明文。: Hide plaintext by converting strings to encoded/array forms.
map.给前端代码里的配置串做简单遮蔽，避免明文被一眼搜到——注意这只是提高偶然发现的门: Apply a simple mask to config strings in front-end code to avoid plaintext being spotted at a glance — note this only raises the bar for accidental discovery, not a security measure.
map.仅增加难度，运行时仍还原。: It only increases difficulty; it is still restored at runtime.
map.密钥能这样藏吗？: Can a key be hidden this way?
map.不能。前端的一切内容最终都会以某种形式暴露给用户，混淆只是增加阅读难度，任何人耐: No. Everything in the front end will ultimately be exposed to the user in some form; obfuscation only adds reading difficulty, and anyone patient enough to debug can reverse it. Real keys must live on the server; the front end should only hold short-lived, revocable, permission-limited tokens. Putting a key in the front end (no matter how obfuscated) is a design error.
